scheme_name: Award of Puducherry State Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant must be a native of the Union Territory of Puducherry either by birth or by continuous residence for at least five years
Applicant must be studying in 11th or 12th standard and must have secured promotion to the next higher class
If studying in 11th standard, the applicant must have secured at least 60% marks in the 10th standard
If studying in 12th standard, the applicant must have secured at least 50% marks in the 11th standard
If applications exceed available slots, selection is made strictly on the basis of merit and school type preference (Government, Government‑aided, then Private)
benefits_summary: Day scholars receive ₹60 per month and hostellers receive ₹100 per month, disbursed directly into the applicant’s Aadhaar‑linked bank account.
